test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

P + Q means ‘P is the father of Q’,

P - Q means ‘P is the son of Q’,

P × Q means ‘P is the wife of Q’

and P ÷ Q means ‘P is the brother of Q’.

Based on the above, how is K related to R if ‘M ÷ N × O + K × L - R'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 father
 son
 Wife
 Brother 
 
 

 

Given: M ÷ N × O + K × L - R

It means: P is the brother of N, N is the wife of O, O is the father of L, L is the son of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be748620aa5de9c18ad0ac469aae1d36afb16eab9d42b9d96b1dd2c55d51c084.png] 

So, K is the '**Son's wife**' of R.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
